PURPOSE: Browser-agent abstraction: typed action schema, index-addressed DOM state capture, schema-validated extraction loop with provenance envelope, page-change-guarded multi-action execution, and URL allow/prohibit + IP-block fetch boundary. Harvest mechanisms (not the runtime) for FYD acquisition and to keep the crawler a commodity worker behind FYD's trust boundary.
SMALLEST_MISSING_PRIMITIVE: Typed provenance-carrying extraction result envelope at the crawler-to-evidence boundary: {data, schema_used, is_partial, source_url, content_stats}. Every acquisition output must declare which schema validated it, which URL it came from, whether content was truncated before extraction, and processing stats. This is what turns raw crawler output into evidence the graph can trust.
